mcq.q: If three binary numbers A,B,C (4 bits each) are added using a carry-save adder, the result will be:

options.B: A 4-bit sum and a 4-bit carry that need final addition.
options.D: A single XOR of all three numbers.

mcq.answer_text: A 4-bit sum and a 4-bit carry that need final addition.

mcq.q: Which of the following is a key characteristic of a Wallace tree multiplier?

options.B: Parallel reduction of partial products using carry-save adders

mcq.answer_text: Parallel reduction of partial products using carry-save adders

mcq.q: Which multiplier architecture is best suited for high-speed applications in modern processors?

options.C: Wallace tree multiplier with carry-lookahead final adder

mcq.answer_text: Wallace tree multiplier with carry-lookahead final adder

mcq.q: A 4×4 array multiplier requires how many AND gates to generate the partial products?
In carry-save addition, which outputs are produced at each step?

options.B: A sum vector and a carry vector

mcq.answer_text: A sum vector and a carry vector
